_README: TEMPLATE for a new plate generation. Copy to gen2_<something>.json (drop the
leading underscore - files starting with '_' are ignored by the scanner) and
edit. Nothing in the application code needs to change: the new generation
appears in the dropdown on the next restart, and `python -m app.plates.registry`
checks that the segments tile the pad grid exactly once before you trust a map.
Two ways to describe the segments:
strips   - generative. Use when the plate is cut into full-height vertical
strips, each strip cut into bands of pad rows (the Gen-1 pattern).
segments - explicit. A rectangle per segment on the pad grid. Use for ANY
arrangement, including ones that are not strip-based. Shown below.
Pad indices are 1-based and inclusive at both ends, matching the drawings.
A segment is a union of whole pads, so its area comes out exact.
Optional per-segment 'area_cm2' overrides the computed area (use only when
the copper is not a full rectangle). Optional 'wiring' maps segment -> card
and channel, kept separate so a re-wiring does not touch the layout.
name: Gen 2 - example, 24 segments
